description: Collectibles C (phase 8 family 04): the 29 Saviors of Uldum collectibles ULD_282, 286, 288, 290, 291, 292, 293, 304, 326, 327, 329, 410, 431, 433, 435, 438, 707, 709, 711, 713, 714, 716, 718, 720, 721, 724, 726, 727, 728. The family has no encounter of its own, so this file lists no boss row: the cards are members of the Tombs of Terror buckets (data/dungeon-run/reference/buckets.json, which records their provenance) and reach a run through the bucket catalog (data/dungeon-run/catalog-v1.json) once scripted. Boss decks of other families that list them take them from their own files: Bloodsworn Mercenary (ULD_720) and Plague of Wrath (ULD_707) in Icarax's lists (F01.json); Shadow of Death (ULD_286), Dune Sculptor (ULD_329) and Swarm of Locusts (ULD_713) in the Tekahn finale's explorer decks (family 24).
method: No wiki transcription: card text, Cost and stats are the client's (facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json). The six Quests are admitted for the run player only (DungeonRunAdmission.F04.cs), so no boss row may list one.
